(() => {
  const target = document.createElement('div');
  target.className = 'vendor-target';
  document.body.append(target);
  const result = {};
  const cases = [
    ['block','@-foreign-feature option { .vendor-target{width:999px} }'],
    ['statement','@-foreign-statement option;'],
    ['media','@media all {@-foreign-feature { .vendor-target{width:999px} }}'],
    ['escaped','@-\\66 oreign-feature { .vendor-target{width:999px} }'],
  ];
  for (const [name, source] of cases) {
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = source + '.vendor-target{width:71px}';
    document.head.append(style);
    result[name] = getComputedStyle(target).width === '71px';
    style.remove();
  }
  target.remove();
  return result;
})()
